captions.detailed: An immersion blender storage unit featuring a cylindrical white housing base with a black bottom trim ring. A black handheld motor unit sits vertically in a slide-out front dock. Connected to the bottom of this motor is a metallic grey blending wand that extends downwards, ending in a wireframe blade guard cage that can rotate relative to the shaft.
captions.instruction: Create an immersion blender stand unit. It should feature a tall cylindrical base housing, a detachable blending wand arm that slides out vertically on a prismatic joint from the housing dock, and a blade guard cage attached via a revolute joint at the bottom tip of the arm.
captions.factory: The base is created by subtracting an inner cylinder from an outer cylinder, with a black bottom ring added. The blending wand arm is modeled by combining a rounded cylinder for the motor handle, a thin cylinder for the shaft, and a rectangular slide mount. The blade guard cage is constructed by sweeping circular wireframes. A prismatic joint connects the wand arm to the base, and a revolute joint connects the blade guard to the bottom tip of the wand.
